summary: ICON plc filed a Form 6-K on May 27, 2026, containing its Q4 and full-year 2025 financial results and the outcome of an Audit Committee investigation into accounting practices. The filing restates revenues (0.8% overstatement in FY2023, 1.1% in FY2024), notes no impact on cash or operations, and issues FY2026 guidance (revenue $7,850M-$8,150M, adjusted EPS $10.00-$11.00). This is a routine earnings report with an accounting investigation conclusion, not a special situation. There are no deal terms, no M&A, and no activist or strategic review. The filing provides standard operational updates and forward guidance, making it a routine current report.
